mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (product_id, parent_id, commenter_id, replier_id, content) VALUES (#{productId}, #{parentId}, #{commenterId}, #{replierId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT id, commenter_id FROM comment WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT c.id, c.content, c.comment_time, c.parent_id, c.commenter_id, u.nickname AS commenter_nickname, u.avatar AS commenter_avatar, ru.nickname AS replier_nickname FROM comment c INNER JOIN user u ON c.commenter_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user ru ON c.replier_id = ru.id WHERE c.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY c.comment_time DESC
SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM comment GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY comment_count DESC

SELECT sub.product_id, sub.comment_count, p.product_name, p.price FROM ( SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM comment GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY comment_count DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) sub INNER JOIN product p ON sub.product_id = p.id

SELECT c.id, c.content, c.comment_time AS createTime, c.parent_id, c.commenter_id, c.product_id, u.username, u.nickname, p.product_name AS productName FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.commenter_id = u.id LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id ORDER BY c.comment_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
